about: Source in/out points (seconds) for the public-domain early acts, against pipeline/footage_list.json (fetch with pipeline/fetch_footage.py). All films first published before 1931. Picture only: the archive uploads' soundtracks are modern additions and were never used.
verified: Every in/out below was used in cloud cut v3 and passed pipeline/flashcheck.py, except entries under 'alternates'.

chapters.suggested_order_note: Opens on Buñuel's razor, then the first trick films, and closes on Méliès's rocket in the moon's eye.

clips.title: Un Chien Andalou
clips.note: Razor, moon, hand at the eye. Out point is before the blade touches the eye (slice ~95 s); keep it for a class audience. This upload is the 1960 sound version; its title cards run 0–60 s.

clips.title: The Man with the Rubber Head
clips.note: The head inflating.

clips.title: The Melomaniac
clips.note: Heads as notes on a stave.

clips.title: The Electric Hotel
clips.note: Boots that move by themselves. The upload's title card says 1905; the film is usually dated 1908.

clips.title: The Electric Hotel
clips.note: Hair combing itself.

clips.title: A Trip to the Moon
clips.note: The moon approaches; the rocket hits its eye at ~439.2 s.

clips.title: Le Retour à la raison
clips.note: Rotating paper shapes and the striped torso. Avoid 12–32 s (rayograph flicker).

clips.title: Entr'acte
clips.note: The ballerina seen from below. Avoid 40–54 s: racist caricature dolls.

clips.title: Emak-Bakia
clips.note: The eyes painted on her eyelids open. Upload's music credits start at ~947 s.

clips.title: Ghosts Before Breakfast
clips.note: Flying hats; starts after the revolver shots.

clips.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
clips.note: Prism-multiplied staircase.

clips.title: Un Chien Andalou
clips.note: Ants in the palm dissolving to armpit hair and a sea urchin.

clips.title: Man with a Movie Camera
clips.note: Window shadows and crowds.

clips.title: Man with a Movie Camera
clips.note: Ends on the eye in the lens (~3995 s). Skips 3982–3990 (rapid cutting flagged by the flash check). The film's end title starts ~3998.5 s.
